hypothesis: Avoid duplicate-key bookkeeping only for proven zero/one-attribute tags in the shared XML auditor; all ambiguous or error probes replay the checked iterator before any semantic/state mutation.
harness_enabler: Separate publication_allocation_metrics vector alongside existing commit counters, identical in baseline and candidate.

allocation.scope: Publication including returned MultiSnapshot drop; commit allocations separately retained as diagnostics.

profile.scope: Exact-name zero-before/dump-after/toggle; sixth unique measured runner call; prior five lifecycle calls retained. Excludes returned MultiSnapshot drop.

admission: Require at least 2% p50 improvement in primary total and at least 5% p50 improvement in primary publication, plus at least 2% mean improvement in primary total in both repeats of both shapes. Require at least 8% publication allocation-call reduction in both allocator repeats/shapes. If these pilot gates pass, require at least 3% publication Ir reduction in both shapes/repeats, full quality and eager guards before retention. Flag every >5% adverse timing, mean, RSS or incremental allocation peak and all >5% absolute same-build drift. Reject if any pilot gate fails; no profiler/hardware speedup claim then. Preserve all captured evidence. No cold/range/native-producer/scaling claim.
native_order: retained baseline native-r2 under candidate source checkout
retained_baseline_custody: Retained baseline binary and build manifest remain hash-bound; candidate checkout source is independently bound during final A2 and differs only in the frozen candidate file inventory.
resource_scope: Unchanged audit scope, attribute/token/aggregate charging, xml:space semantics and ordered checked fallback.

hardware.scope: Whole fresh child including corpus/setup/publication/oracles; diagnostic only, not isolated commit counters.

candidate_source_binding: Exact source file inventory and SHA256 values captured independently for each stage; candidate diff must be nonempty and entirely within candidate_source_roots. Harness source is identical. Review exact production/test patch before application.

conditional_lanes.profile: Required for retention only after pilot gates pass; preserved baseline binaries may run under candidate checkout.
conditional_lanes.hardware: Diagnostic only after pilot gates pass.
conditional_lanes.eager: Required before retention; no primary gain claim.
